verdict.rationale: Docs confirm robust trial support via the Trial Offer API (managing free and paid introductory periods, reducing trial abuse) and general webhook infrastructure for status transitions, but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of coupons, promotion codes, or the specific trial-end notification webhook (e.g. customer.subscription.trial_will_end) required by card-network rules. missing for 10: coupon/promotion-code creation and redemption docs, explicit trial-end notification event documentation, independent confirmation these work together for automatic paid conversion.
